reviews.name: Samiran Mukherjee
reviews.title: A device which is easy to deploy and works as it claims in product description
reviews.body:
First thing first, it does not remove hardness, but it surely removes problems related to hard water. I received the device on 23 Sep 18. After one hour I tested the water with a hardness testing kit purchased from amazon. I found the hardness of water is not changed. The product also claims that it does not remove hardness. Since deployment till today I observed, that the water has become clear. Now the bathrooms are not getting stained. Hair no more feel sticky. The best part is it does not need any changes with your existing setup. Just put inside tank and forget.
Some times, one might find that the product is floating in water. Look at the image I attached. If the device is tilted inside the water the trapped air is removed and it will go down in water. The product will start floating when the inside white media is consumed indicating a need for replacement. The customer care of the product is also very supportive. My suggestion, use it once and you will love it.

I used it for 6 months after which it started floating at the top meaning its life was over since the company said it should last for a year if not they provide a replacement and I emailed them for a replacement and they were very quick to respond. Within a short time after I emailed them that too on a sunday they reached out to me and inquired about how did I find the product, the manager Mr Rajesh and a member of technical team Mr. Uday talked to me and assured me that they would ship a replacement straightaway. The attached pic is after the life of the product was over and the white deposit at the bottom suggests that it indeed absorbs the minerals and substances responsible for hard water.

Update 29 July 2020: I received the replacement in July last year and the new d'cal is still working and has not started floating even after a year. Great product and great customer service.

I have been using D'cal since 15 days now.D'cal has played a big role in stopping the damage to my washing machine, heating rod, geysers​ (as they take less time to heat water as there is no layering around them hence I save on electricity bills!) water tank, buckets, utensils, clothes during washing as they feel much softer n bright. I don't feel itching, dryness & roughness on my skin & hair anymore after bathing. I use less soap & detergents.
So basically the savings & benefits are much more than the cost of D'cal water softener. So why won't use it?! :)
